title: FBI-UAP-D026, FD-302, “Dark Translucent Triangle,” 2023
doc_notes: This document is an FBI FD-302 interview record regarding a UAP sighting in Colorado Springs, containing significant redactions of personal names and specific location details.

incidents.summary: A former Department of War employee and his wife observed a silent, translucent, triangular object flying at low altitude over their residence in Colorado Springs.
incidents.color: dark gray or silver with a band of silverish blue light
incidents.quote: The UAP looked like a perfect triangle, however because of his viewing angle, he couldn't definitively say whether it was isosceles or equilateral
